page.layout: One centred column of title-page text, from top to bottom: the title lines, "PAR", the author's name, an italic edition line, a printer's device (woodcut engraving) in the middle, then the imprint and date at the foot.

main_text.l: Si une Femme a esté assise au

page.notes: Woodcut device between the edition line and the imprint: an armillary sphere held up by a winged figure on the left and a standing figure with a staff on the right, with a banner reading "INDEFESSVS AGENDO" across the base. Not transcribed as text, as it is an engraving. The imprint's publisher name is printed "BLAEV" (the final letter is a vowel, so it is given as BLAEU). The date is printed in reversed-C numerals "CIↃ IↃ C XLIX", given as MDCXLIX. The long s is printed throughout as s in the scan and is given as plain s. The title's letter-spaced capitals (F A M I L I E R, D E L A) are given without spacing.
